patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — n8n and Rank Prompt share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

n8n and Rank Prompt share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose n8n only if your buying job matches “Workflow automation — Community self-host free; Cloud Starter €20/mo annual (2.5k executio” rather than Rank Prompt's shape. Choose Rank Prompt only if your buying job matches “AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI category.” rather than n8n's shape. Workflow advantage differs because n8n is shaped for Workflow automation — Community self-host free; Cloud Starter €20/mo a whereas Rank Prompt is shaped for AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI cat. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — n8n and Rank Prompt share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: n8n is Workflow automation — Community self-host free; Cloud Starter €20/mo annual (2.5k executions + AI credits); Pro €50; Business €667; Enterpri; Rank Prompt is AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI category..
- Company-size focus: n8n (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs Rank Prompt (small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: n8n — Cloud prices are EUR — startingPriceMonthly 20 is the Starter euro floor, not a USD SKU; Rank Prompt — GEO/AEO niche — not general-purpose AI writing.

Limitations — n8n: Cloud prices are EUR — startingPriceMonthly 20 is the Starter euro floor, not a USD SKU; Community Edition is self-host ops work — not a hosted Free Zapier-style 100-task sandbox; Rank Prompt: GEO/AEO niche — not general-purpose AI writing.

Poor-fit cases: n8n is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud prices are EUR — startingPriceMonthly 20 is the Starter euro floor, not a USD SKU · Rank Prompt is a poor fit when that limitation bites: GEO/AEO niche — not general-purpose AI writing · Avoid n8n if you actually need Rank Prompt's motion (AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI category.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
